sessionStart.powershell: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $h='http://127.0.0.1:5244/health'; try { if((Invoke-WebRequest $h -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2).StatusCode -eq 200){ exit 0 } } catch {}; $root=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'narnia'; $app=Join-Path $root 'app'; $launcher=Join-Path $root 'start-server.ps1'; if(Test-Path $launcher){ $quotedLauncher='"'+$launcher+'"'; Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$quotedLauncher) -WorkingDirectory $app -WindowStyle Hidden } else { $exe=Join-Path $app 'NexusLabs.Narnia.Web.exe'; $dll=Join-Path $app 'NexusLabs.Narnia.Web.dll'; $runtime=Join-Path $app 'NexusLabs.Narnia.Web.runtimeconfig.json'; $frameworkDependent=$false; if(Test-Path $runtime){ try { $options=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $runtime -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).runtimeOptions; $frameworkDependent=$null -ne $options.framework -or $null -ne $options.frameworks } catch {} }; if($frameworkDependent -and (Test-Path $dll)){ $dotnet=(Get-Command dotnet.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if($dotnet){ $quotedDll='"'+$dll+'"'; Start-Process -FilePath $dotnet -ArgumentList @($quotedDll,'--urls','http://127.0.0.1:5244') -WorkingDirectory $app -WindowStyle Hidden } } elseif(Test-Path $exe){ Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList '--urls','http://127.0.0.1:5244' -WorkingDirectory $app -WindowStyle Hidden } }; for($i=0;$i -lt 12;$i++){ Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800; try { if((Invoke-WebRequest $h -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2).StatusCode -eq 200){ break } } catch {} }; exit 0
sessionStart.bash: curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5244/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; D="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/narnia/app"; [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ] && D="$HOME/Library/Application Support/narnia/app"; if [ -f "$D/NexusLabs.Narnia.Web.dll" ]; then (cd "$D" && nohup dotnet ./NexusLabs.Narnia.Web.dll --urls http://127.0.0.1:5244 >/dev/null 2>&1 &); for i in $(seq 1 12); do sleep 1; curl -sf --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5244/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; done; fi; exit 0
